card.name: Linking words after bradycardia and frame rates
card.fires_on: Commas, 'including' or 'of' right after 'bradycardia' or heart-rhythm terms in drug warnings, and the space before a frame-rate number like 23.976fps.

modes.label: After bradycardia
modes.description: Comma or linking word right after bradycardia or a rhythm problem, before the next item in the list.
modes.example: 5.2 Bradycardia Bradycardia,<< including>> sinus pause, heart block, severe br

modes.label: Frame rate numbers
modes.description: Blank spot just before a video frame rate value such as 23.976fps or 24fps.

card.writes: Weak signal; promoted tokens hint at speed or acceleration, with no clear output effect on the lists.
card.plain: It fires on the small joining word or comma after a slow-heart-rate term, and also before frame-rate numbers in video text.
